## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The header check in `app/report.py` is correct, and `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` covers it. The only correction is optional: `test_rejects_legacy_header` can never fail, so it should be fixed or removed.

## Changes
`parse_report` now accepts only the exact header `REPORT v1`. Before this change it accepted any header starting with `REPORT `. The pull request also adds two tests that check unsupported headers are rejected.

## Suggestions
- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Make test_rejects_legacy_header exercise the header check — The fixture `"REPORT v1\nversion=v1"` has no `END` line, so `parse_report` returns `None` at the END check whatever the header says. `rsplit("v1", 1)` also rewrites `version=v1` and leaves the `REPORT v1` header unchanged. Both facts contradict the comment at line 9: "changing the fixture's version to v0". — The test would still pass if the header check were removed, so it adds no regression protection and misleads maintainers about what is covered. — Fix: Build the fixture as `"REPORT v0\nvalue=ok\nEND"`, or delete the test because `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` already covers that input.
